parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans identity, no documented border/document friction for visitors, no documented trans-specific street violence or police profiling — but a documented state threat-framing tier: the top court's biological-sex interpretation of the equality act (Apr 2025), a statutory single-sex-spaces code in force since Aug 2026 (UN experts warn it institutionalises discrimination), custody and strip-search policies moved to birth-sex basis, prison placement by birth sex enforced after the 2026 ruling, and announced hospital ward exclusion — with one documented care-denial death (Joelle) under litigation. Institutions efficiently enforcing hostile rules are exposure per the liability clause. Media hostility is documented and rising; rule of law mitigates only marginally here. No executions, arrests, or organised sweeps. Sits at the top of Elevated Risk.
